verdict.rationale: DeepSeek maintains a dedicated 'updates' changelog page documenting API/model changes (new models like V4.1 Flash, native Responses API support, Vision-Exp release) and dated deprecation notices with advance warning and alias mapping for retiring legacy model names, giving developers a followable lifecycle record. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration that the changelog is comprehensive or reliably followed, and no subscription/RSS mechanism mentioned.
